changes.title: Call from any phone.
changes.text: The current homepage is a 2013 layout that shrinks on a phone, and 281-931-5656 can't be tapped. The concept puts a tap to call button at the top of every screen.

changes.title: A repair request, not just a phone number.
changes.text: Today the only way to reach you is to call or copy your email address from the Contact page. The concept adds a short request where a customer describes the motor and the problem.

changes.title: Your rating and your shop up front.
changes.text: You have 26 Google reviews and a gallery of real repairs, but the homepage shows neither. The concept leads with your 4.2 rating and photos of motors on your floor.
